_comment: Curated protocol -> minted/backed stablecoin map for the depeg watch (Increment E). Values are {symbol: coins.llama.fi coin-id}. Only protocols that MINT or algorithmically back a USD-pegged coin are listed; everything else is 'no direct peg exposure' (an honest exclusion, not a zero-risk score). Extensible: add a slug -> coin entry and the scorer/alert pick it up with no code change.
